title: Translated-unit comparison on K-flat cone triangles
statement: Let f:Z→Y be proper between Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in one localization universe, recorded derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback], and a supplied strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Write c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] for [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exists a single e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] such that, for every cochain morphism p:P→Q between K-flat O_Y-complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], with T=Qh.mapTriangle(mappingCone.triangleh p), the triangle with first maps F(T.mor₁), F(T.mor₂) and last map F(T.mor₃) followed by F(c_Y(T.obj₁) inverse), the supplied inverse tensorator δ_(O_Y[1],T.obj₁), e tensor id, and c_Z(F(T.obj₁)) is distinguished in D(O_Z). Only explicit cone triangles of K-flat morphisms are asserted here.

source.place: K-flat mapping-cone calculation and translated-unit normalization in the proof of lem-sc-derived-pullback-translated-unit-triangles; Stacks 06YJ, with the supplied-tensorator normalization expanded by the agent.

proof.text: The actual termwise tensor pullback E is a left adjoint by the recorded module-pullback adjunction. Hence E is right exact and additive. Apply the K-flat counit connecting-map normalization to obtain e and epsilon, with components invertible on K-flat complexes.

The cone of p:P→Q is K-flat by isKFlat_mappingCone. The components of epsilon at P, Q and this cone are therefore isomorphisms. The homotopy cone is distinguished, and the additive induced homotopy functor followed by derived localization preserves distinguished triangles (Mathlib mappingCone_triangleh_distinguished and Functor.map_distinguished). Thus W is distinguished.

Use the three invertible components of epsilon as the components of Triangle.isoMk from the displayed normalized pullback triangle to W. Its first two squares are epsilon.naturality at C.mor1 and C.mor2. The third is the connecting-map normalization equality, reversed and reassociated. Transport distinguishedness from W across this isomorphism by isomorphic_distinguished.

proof_origin.place: K-flat cone exactness via the natural counit: first two squares from naturality, cone K-flatness from closure, and third square from the new connecting-map normalization lemma.
